description: Hello I'm Jerrick, and alongside my co-founder Reeve, we're two 15 y.o devs building AstroPulse—a health monitoring software for astronauts on space missions. I handle the coding and architecture, driven by my goal of working in cybersecurity. Reeve leads our strategy and aerospace systems planning backed by straight Level 9s in IGCSE, as he works toward a career in aerospace engineering.
